probes.name: array_fraction_limit
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim count As Long, log As String
Dim values(0) As Integer
For values(0) = 1 To 1.5
count = count+1
log = log & CStr(values(0)) & ";"
If count >= 8 Then Exit For
Next
Probe = log & "|" & CStr(values(0))
End Function

probes.name: index_once
probes.source:
Private calls As Long
Function SlotIndex() As Long
calls=calls+1
SlotIndex=0
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim values(0) As Integer, log As String
For values(SlotIndex()) = 1 To 2
log = log & CStr(values(0)) & ":" & CStr(calls) & ";"
Next
Probe = log & "|" & CStr(calls)
End Function

probes.name: index_changes
probes.source:
Private calls As Long
Function SlotIndex() As Long
calls=calls+1
SlotIndex = (calls-1) Mod 2
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim values(1) As Integer, count As Long, log As String
For values(SlotIndex()) = 1 To 2
count=count+1
log=log & CStr(values(0)) & ":" & CStr(values(1)) & ":" & CStr(calls) & ";"
If count>=6 Then Exit For
Next
Probe=log & "|" & CStr(calls)
End Function

probes.name: counter_resize
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim values() As Integer, log As String, seen As Long
ReDim values(0)
On Error Resume Next
For values(0) = 1 To 2
Err.Clear
ReDim Preserve values(1)
seen=Err.Number
log=log & CStr(values(0)) & ":" & CStr(seen) & ";"
Next
Probe=log & "|" & CStr(values(0)) & ":" & CStr(UBound(values))
End Function

probes.name: array_jump_integer
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim log As String, count As Long
Dim values(0) As Integer
On Error GoTo Failed
GoTo Body
For values(0) = 1 To 2
Body:
count=count+1
log=log & CStr(CDbl(values(0))) & ";"
If count>=4 Then Exit For
Next
Probe=log & "|" & CStr(CDbl(values(0)))
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe=log & "!" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
